blocks.text: Reference grammar A1

This part collects in tables everything you have studied in the units A1-01 → A1-19. It does not replace the explanations of units: it is used to review, check a form while writing and preparing tests. The reference unit shall be indicated for each argument. The marked forms are not required in the production of A1.
G1 · The name: gender and determination

Genre (A1-03). Female is usually recognized by the ⁧ة⁩ ; women are also female by nature ( ⁧أُمّ، بِنْت، أُخْت⁩ ), names of cities and almost all countries, some words to memorize ( ⁧شَمْس، أَرْض، حَرْب، دَار⁩ ) and double body parts ( ⁧يَد، عَيْن⁩ ). The names of man in ⁧ة⁩ ( ⁧حَمْزَة، أُسَامَة⁩ ) are male.

G2 · Personal pronouns (A1-02, A1-12)
3a female ⁧هِيَ⁩ hiya ⁧هُمَا⁩ humā ⁧هُنَّ⁩ hunna
The nominal sentence does not have the verb ⁧أَنَا طَالِبٌ⁩ I'm a student. A second pronoun is not added: ⁧أَنَا هُوَ طَالِبٌ⁩ It's a mistake.
G3 · The Suffix Pronouns (A1-09, A1-12)
3a female ⁧ـهَا⁩ -hā ⁧ـهُمَا⁩ -humā ⁧ـهُنَّ⁩ -hunna
Form rules.
1. The ⁧ة⁩ in front of the suffix becomes ⁧ت⁩ : ⁧سَيَّارَة⁩ → ⁧سَيَّارَتِي⁩ .
2. In front of the suffix the name keeps the vowel of the case: ⁧بَيْتُكَ⁩ (No.), ⁧فِي بَيْتِكَ⁩ (Gen.), ⁧أَعْرِفُ بَيْتَكَ⁩ (a.c.).
With ⁧ـِي⁩ The vowel of the case disappears.
3. After the , ī or ay, -hu, -hum, -humā, -hunna become -hi, -him, -himā, -Hinna: . ⁧فِي بَيْتِهِ، عَلَيْهِمْ⁩
4. ⁧أَب⁩ and ⁧أَخ⁩ elongate the vowel of the case in front of the suffix and in theiḍāfa: ⁧أَبُوكَ⁩ (No.), ⁧أَبَاكَ⁩ (a.k.a.), ⁧أَبِيكَ⁩ (Gen.);
with ⁧ـِي⁩ stays ⁧أَبِي⁩ .
5. The suffix makes the name determined: an adjective that follows takes the article: . ⁧سَيَّارَتِي الجَدِيدَةُ⁩
G4 · Prepositions (A1-08, A1-12)
The name after a preposition is at the genitive: ⁧فِي البَيْتِ الكَبِيرِ، مِنْ مِصْرَ⁩ (diptoth: -a without article).
With the suffixes.
⁧عَلَيْهِعَلَيْكِعَلَيْكَعَلَيَّعَلَى⁩ ⁧عَلَيْهَا⁩
• Have • (A1-08). There is no verb: a preposition is used with the possessor, and the possessed thing is the subject (nominative).
⁧مَعَ⁩ what you have with you ⁧مَعِي جَوَازُ سَفَرِي⁩
Added to the past ⁧كَانَ⁩ : ⁧كَانَ عِنْدِي اجْتِمَاعٌ⁩ I had a meeting. Denial: ⁧لَيْسَ عِنْدِي سَيَّارَةٌ⁩ (present), ⁧مَا كَانَ عِنْدِي وَقْتٌ⁩ (past).

G7 · The nisba (A1-07)
Adding ⁧ـِيّ⁩ ( m.) / ⁧ـِيَّة⁩ (f.) to the name of the country or city, removing the article and any ⁧ة⁩ or ⁧ـَا⁩ Final.
The same rule forms adjectives from many names: ⁧شُرْطَة⁩ → ⁧شُرْطِيّ، أَمْن⁩ → ⁧أَمْنِيّ، دَوْلَة⁩ → ⁧دَوْلِيّ⁩ . The language is said with the determined female: . ⁧العَرَبِيَّةُ، الإِيطَالِيَّةُ⁩
G8 · The adjective and the agreement (A1-03, A1-04, A1-15)
The attribute adjective follows the name and usually copies it, number, case and determination. The predicate copy genre and number, but it is indeterminate.

Also applies to verbs, pronouns and demonstration: ⁧الدُّرُوسُ تَبْدَأُ صَبَاحًا⁩ · . ⁧الكُتُبُ عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ، وَهِيَ صَعْبَةٌ⁩ Deny an adjective with ⁧غَيْر⁩ ( A1-16): ⁧الشَّقَّةُ غَيْرُ مَفْرُوشَةٍ⁩ The apartment is not furnished. ⁧هِجْرَةٌ غَيْرُ قَانُونِيَّةٍ⁩ • irregular immigration • irregular immigration.

blocks.text: Iḍāfa or name + adjective? First name without article → iḍāfa ( ⁧جَامِعَةُ القَاهِرَةِ⁩ ); two articles → name + adjective ( ⁧الجَامِعَةُ الأَمْرِيكِيَّةُ⁩ ). This is the first analysis to be done on the titles. The dual and the healthy male plural lose the ⁧ن⁩ as the first term (recognize): ⁧مُوَظَّفُو الوِزَارَةِ⁩ The Ministry's employees are:

G11 · Numbers, age, hours (A1-11, A1-17)

The figures are also read from left to right in the Arabic text: ⁧٢٠٢٦⁩ = 2026. Dozens (A1-11): ⁧عِشْرُونَ⁩ 20 · ⁧ثَلَاثُونَ⁩ 30 · ⁧أَرْبَعُونَ⁩ 40 · ⁧خَمْسُونَ⁩ 50 · ⁧سِتُّونَ⁩ 60 · ⁧سَبْعُونَ⁩ 70 · ⁧ثَمَانُونَ⁩ 80 · ⁧تِسْعُونَ⁩ 90 · ⁧مِئَة⁩ 100. After the dozens the name is to the singular accusative: . ⁧عِشْرُونَ سَنَةً⁩ The age: ⁧عُمْرِي ثَلَاثُونَ سَنَةً⁩ I'm 30 years old. ⁧كَمْ عُمْرُكَ؟⁩ How old are you? Number and name (recognize; is studied in A2). From 3 a 10 the number is followed by the genitive plural and takes the genus ⁧ثَلَاثَةُ كُتُبٍ⁩ • three books • ⁧ثَلَاثُ سَيَّارَاتٍ⁩ Three autos. Ordinary (A1-17).
Hours use the female ordinary (concord with ⁧سَاعَة⁩ ).

G12 · The verb: the imperfect (A1-13, A1-14)
The imperfect (present, habit) has established and, in some people, suffixes. The vowel of the theme (u, a, i) you learn with the verb.
The two of them (f.) ⁧تَعْرِفَانِتَعْمَلَانِتَدْرُسَانِـَانِ⁩ … ⁧تَـ⁩

Verbs with prefix in -u- (A1-13, A1-14): ⁧يُحِبُّ⁩ ( ⁧أُحِبُّ، تُحِبِّينَ⁩ ), ⁧يُرِيدُ⁩ ( ⁧أُرِيدُ⁩ ), ⁧يُسَاعِدُ⁩ ( ⁧أُسَاعِدُ⁩ ), ⁧يُتَرْجِمُ⁩ ( ⁧أُتَرْجِمُ⁩ ). Verbs with long vowel in the theme: ⁧يَقُولُ، يَزُورُ، يَنَامُ، يَعِيشُ⁩ ( ⁧أَقُولُ، أَزُورُ⁩ ). Verbs in tafaʿʿala : ⁧يَتَكَلَّمُ، يَتَعَلَّمُ⁩
The object of the supplement is to accuse: ⁧أَقْرَأُ الجَرِيدَةَ⁩ · . ⁧أَكْتُبُ رِسَالَةً⁩
